context.strain: PO1f in W29/CLIB89 background; current archived SD-Leu plasmid-selection profile

target_identity_convention: Ordered ordinary alpha-linked free dipeptides with L chiral residues; chemistry candidate may remain a named-identity hypothesis, see dipeptide_identity.tsv

endogenous.net_growth_accounting: Existing biomass handles net-growth protein; additional replacement synthesis must be sourced and separately costed. No reverse biomass or unsourced protein_pool.
endogenous.turnover_relation: v_deg=kdeg*P; vacuolar_share=f_va*v_deg; v_synthesis=mu*P+v_deg for a maintained pool
endogenous.cleavage_accounting: Fractions of mutually exclusive, nonoverlapping cut patterns; all other residues/products retained and assigned destinations; all four products compete for shared Gly.

activation_requirements: all fields backed by source and units
precursor supply and replacement energy paid without double-counting net growth
bounded rates and complete residue ledger
new authorized candidate with energy/culture/rollback checks
forbidden_shortcuts: reverse hydrolysis with no synthesis mechanism/energy
independent reuse of the same Gly residues
all protein turnover forced through four target reactions
parameter_validation_limits: Checker verifies finite values, units, cleavage positions/nonoverlap, residue remainder and proposed supply budgets; it does not validate evidence truth, full chemical equations or grant activation.
